summary: Venu Holding Corp filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $250M of common stock through ThinkEquity LLC as sales agent. The shares will be sold at prevailing market prices; no fixed price, premium, or per-share terms are stated. The company is the issuer, and this is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4). The filing reports a last sale price of $3.33 on June 9, 2026. The Sales Agent receives a 3% commission. This represents routine capital-raising and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring.
